title: Which AI for Art ?
author: Nhoo_
selftext:
Hello, 

I'm thinking about developing a game and I was wondering which AI is the best for the art game and animation ? 

I'm still not sure if I want some cartoon style or pixel art style btw. A lot of assets already exist in pixel art but I don't really love it. However I'm afraid to loose consistency if I'm trying to use cartoon style 🫪

I already have some assets of creator but they are not animated... I'm currently thinking about using AI as I'm solo and I already use it to help me. 

Thank you in advance for your help !

comments.author: Meatt
comments.body: Pixellab has been great for characters and animations, 40 generations for free and then 5 per day, which has been fine so far just generating things as I need them every day. I also use gpt free to get a few things per day, and elevenlabs if I need to.

comments.author: inb7_banned
comments.body:
write a couple style guides of how you want stuff to look for the whole game

make ai improve it

READ IT (and fix what you dont like)

open claude code connect with krea

tell claude you want to create X asset using the styleguide Y. make it create the same asset 3 times using 3 different generative ais (krea has them all)

compare them

then you can pick your favorite styleguide+modell combo and stick withit
